Metadata.defaultTitle: Brami – saffron cosmetics and natural Bulgarian cosmetics
Metadata.description: Brami is a Bulgarian online shop for saffron cosmetics, made with saffron grown in Bulgaria, and natural cosmetics for face, body and hair. Shampoos, creams and shower gels, delivered across Bulgaria.
Metadata.ogDescription: Saffron cosmetics and natural Bulgarian cosmetics for face, body and hair – with fast delivery across Bulgaria.
Metadata.organizationDescription: Brami (Brami Trade) is a Bulgarian company that grows saffron (Crocus sativus) in Bulgaria and makes the natural cosmetics line Saffron Adela Sunny – shampoos, conditioners, shower gels, creams and soaps with saffron. Its online shop brami.shop also offers selected Bulgarian natural cosmetics by Voditsa and Shafpol Beauty.
Metadata.saffronLineDescription: Natural cosmetics with Bulgarian saffron (Crocus sativus, ISO 3632) – the first Bulgarian line of hair and body wash products with saffron.
